svg.title: For a general expression choose its centered approximation at precision min(q, q−maxFee(w)−wu). Projection of its error costs at most maxFee(w)+wu, where maxFee(w) = Pw j=0 probeFee(j). Both the original error and its projection consequently fit precision q. Subtract them and use the finite- sum result for the approximation. Since q was arbitrary, (UC3) follows. At u = s, simply subtract the projected affordable expression, with no gain. Repetition of (UC3) supplies the full w + 1 gain at every signed ancestor move of the contact forest.
